page.layout: One printed title page, full width. Top lines in large capitals, then the title in larger type with the printer's imprint at the foot. A small woodcut or engraving sits in the centre-lower part of the page. Show-through from the reverse mirrors much of the text and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Most of the title page is badly damaged and faint. Much of the text is show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. Lines marked [?] or [illegible] are uncertain readings of the scan. The imprint year may read differently from what is shown here. The central engraving or woodcut (a figure-like image within a frame) is described only and not transcribed.
